metadata.question: Did Wilmington, North Carolina receive at least 90 inches of rainfall during the year of 2018?

data.raw_code: To answer this question about rainfall in Wilmington, North Carolina in 2018, I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - likely from CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which provides daily precipitation data 2. Define a geometry for Wilmington, NC area 3. Filter for the year 2018 4. Sum the daily precipitation to get annual total 5. Check if it's >= 90 inches (need to convert from mm to inches) Let me break this down: - CHIRPS collection: 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' - Band: 'precipitation' - Time range: 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31 - Location: Wilmington, NC (approx lat/long: 34.2104, -77.8868) - Need to convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) I should create a small buffer around Wilmington to get regional rainfall data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wilmington = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.8868, 34.2104]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Wilmington const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(wilmington); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 CHIRPS Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum annual precipitation const annualPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = annualPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wilmington, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation in mm, convert to inches const precipMm = annualPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wilmington, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || !isFinite(precipMm)) { console.log("C3"); return; } const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; // Convert mm to inches console.log(`Annual Precipitation: ${precipInches.toFixed(1)} inches`); console.log(`Target: 90 inches`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipInches >= 90) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
